ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organism is an example of a producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web. At the bottom, the green labels include “phytoplankton” and “algae.” Arrows lead upward from these bottom organisms toward animals such as parrotfish, turtles, marine omnivores, and marine invertebrates. Reasoning: In a food web, producers are organisms at the base that make their own food and provide energy to consumers. Since phytoplankton is shown at the base of the diagram with arrows leading to consumers, phytoplankton is an example of a producer.
